body.x: Steve Lee, CEO of EVAR, participated in the 'Startup Zone' at the Eureka Park K-STARTUP integrated hall of 'CES 2023' in Las Vegas, USA from January 5 (Thursday) to 8 (Sunday, local time) for a total of 4 days.
EVAR is a company that creates the most efficient charging infrastructure to meet the convenience of users in order to achieve 'an electric vehicle life without charging worries'

The main products introduced at this exhibition are the Smart EV Charger, which received the Innovation Award at CES 2022, the Van Mounted Charger (hereinafter referred to as VMC), and Parky. In response to the recent increase in electric vehicles and the resulting charging issues, related solutions are being introduced. The Smart EV Charger is a charger that applies Load Balancing between chargers using BLE, maximizing efficiency in power usage.

The VMC is a charger that allows for a mobile charging service, has the advantage of being able to charge rapidly, and also charge itself rapidly. It is capable of providing emergency service in the event of battery depletion during electric vehicle operation and is an 'On-Demand' charger that goes to where the customer wants and charges.

Furthermore, Parky is a charger that allows for charging of cars that are parked anywhere. EVAR introduces it as "the world's first autonomous charging robot that combines autonomous driving technology, charging technology, and battery technology," and adds, "We are providing solutions that allow for easy electric vehicle charging and efficient energy use with these various charger solutions.

They also revealed the background for product development. The company representative said, "We were filled with a sense of urgency as we saw the rapid melting of ice in the Arctic and Antarctic due to global warming and decided that we needed to pass on a healthy earth to our children. In order to do this, we need to prioritize 'decarbonization', and we thought the best way to practice this practically is to reduce the use of fossil fuels.

Furthermore, they emphasized, "However, in order to expand these eco-friendly vehicles, infrastructure deployment must come first. Just as the expansion of roads facilitated human convenience when Ford invented and developed automobiles, we envision that the deployment of charging infrastructure will expand eco-friendly vehicles and ultimately become a cornerstone in creating a healthy earth.

Based on this background, the Smart EV Charger, a continuous charging station, was born and recognized for its innovation at CES 2022, and also ranked first in MS among new chargers in Korea. In addition, VMC is currently preparing for a pilot project in Canada.

The representative said, "Through CES, which is attended by countries around the world, we aim to showcase EVAR's technology and realize the 2050 decarbonization plan. In the future, we plan to develop and release charging stations that can be developed further from the current ones, a wireless charging autonomous charging robot, a fast-charging station with ultra-short response, and a charging station that can diagnose batteries. In addition, we will develop charging stations suitable for mechanical parking lots to increase convenience for electric vehicle users to charge in various environments.

Additionally, they announced their plan to manage charging stations through a cloud-based charging service platform, enabling anyone to start an electric vehicle charging business and accelerate the deployment of the charging infrastructure. In addition, they will continue to develop and commercialize electric vehicle charging related carbon-cutting technologies.

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.

The K-STARTUP Joint Pavilion featured joint participation of institutions like the Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development, Seoul Business Agency, and Seoul Digital Foundation, as well as 51 Korean innovative companies, to enter the US market and discover global partners. In addition, university student supporters of CES 2023 chosen by each university (Kyunghee, Kookmin, Sogang, Chung-Ang) matched to participating companies based on their respective majors and fields of business.
